about_the_game:
💀 NightMaze

It all started as a harmless urban exploration in the sewers… until the gate slammed shut behind you. Don’t panic: there’s a ladder! Unfortunately, it leads straight into a ruined medieval castle… and a cursed village where everyone has turned into hungry zombies.

Your mission? Find the key, dodge the castle’s traps, grab whatever loot you can, and survive the final nightmare: a shifting labyrinth crawling with the undead. Somewhere between panic attacks and nervous laughter, things will get messy.

🗝️ Key Features:
🧩 Procedural Labyrinth – Every run is randomly generated, no two escapes are the same.
🧟 Reactive Monsters – They hunt using sight, sound, and your every mistake.
🛡️ Loot & Survive – Scavenge weapons, gear, and weird items that might just save you.
😂 Horror meets dark humor – Terrifying and hilarious, all at once.

👉 Join the Discord for updates, feedback, and screams:

short_description: What started as a simple urbex quickly turns into a nightmare: locked sewers, a trapped castle, a ruined village, and a procedural maze swarming with zombies. In co-op, search, loot, dodge, and survive together—before the undead find you first.
